Inside Module.create's callback after config the collection takes Rack's raw vector edits (item assignment, del, insert, append, clear, resize; negative indices); the seal validates matching sizes, non-null quantities/port metadata, module/ID/type per slot and bypass routes, failing construction with ValueError. After the seal: no slot assignment or structural edit (OwnershipError) and identity fields frozen. Main thread only. JSON is RP-15; quantity mixed overrides RP-22. Linux host tested; macOS/Windows unvalidated.

entries.notes: RP-14B2b6 (tk-rackpy-14b2b6-transferred-parameter-quantity-cla-5ebbcc): quantity_type=None configures Rack's built-in quantity and returns a checked ParamQuantityView/SwitchQuantityView (RP-14B2a). quantity_type=<ParamQuantity/SwitchQuantity or Python subclass> is the template: Rack's arguments are validated first, then RackPy constructs quantity_type() on the main thread inside the constructor callback, requires a new instance of exactly that class, rechecks phase/ID, transfers native ownership into the slot (counted pybind11 disown), sets exactly the template's fields and the Param default. Replacement, close, GC, worker drop and rollback reclaim and retire it (StaleHandleError, alive False). Rack callers (no GIL) get native mixed semantics and contained ui overrides; mixed overrides are refused at class definition (RP-22). Smoothing on these unregistered modules is refused from Python; engine registration is RP-16. Linux host tested; macOS/Windows unvalidated.
